fields.FIR_Description: During the early morning of 2025-06-05, around 06:30, the complainant reported repeated harassment by a neighbour over a payment settlement near Roja Park Main Street in Coimbatore, according to the complaint recorded on 2025-06-07. The online submission was made by Yogesh Balan (9000000338). Dinesh Subramani (9000000212) was mentioned as a person who was present nearby. Senthil Krishnan (mobile 9000000461) was named as a possible person of interest. The complainant noted the registration number TN-38-YY-1028 of a black car.
